explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1126 (de Bruijn and Jurkat). If f(x+y) = f(x) + f(y) for almost every (x,y) with respect to planar Lebesgue measure (volume.prod volume), then some everywhere-additive g agrees with f almost everywhere. f is not required to be measurable, which matches the source, where non-measurable f is the interesting case.
